Problem Statement:
A data processing system requires that input data be reversed without using any extra memory. The reversal must be performed in-place on the given string. Write a program to reverse the string in-place. 
Input Description:
The input is a string that needs to be reversed in-place. 
Output Description:
The output is the string after it has been reversed in-place. 
Sample Input:
"hello" 
Sample Output:
Reversed string: "olleh"
